subject.title: fix(agents): stop inflating subagent spawn depth from /new rollover

question: Should dashboard-created child sessions that currently have `parentSessionKey` but no `spawnedBy` remain subject to `maxSpawnDepth` after fixing `/new` rollover sessions?
rationale: Current source and tests establish that these two relationship fields have different meanings, but the PR removes one relationship from depth policy globally; the intended boundary must be confirmed before selecting the narrow repair.

options.title: Preserve dashboard enforcement
options.body: Keep dashboard child sessions depth-limited and mark direct `/new` rollover sessions explicitly as depth 0 or with a distinct rollover relation.

options.title: Redefine dashboard children as roots
options.body: Accept that dashboard-created child sessions may spawn as depth 0 and update the documented depth-policy contract deliberately.

recommendation.title: Preserve dashboard enforcement
recommendation.body: Keep dashboard child sessions depth-limited and mark direct `/new` rollover sessions explicitly as depth 0 or with a distinct rollover relation.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged `/new` lifecycle change is the closest concrete history link to the conflicting rollover and parent-linkage semantics.
